data.credibility: Management shows mixed credibility, occasionally delivering on specific milestones like OSAT, but frequently missing major financial targets such as revenue guidance and working capital days. They also drop long-term goals or heavy capex items without updates.

lines.line: Promised INR 4,500 crores revenue, delivered INR 3,626.4 crores.
OSAT facility commercial production by December 2025 kept.
PCB plant operational readiness expected January 2026 is slipping.
Promised sub-70 working capital days, delivered 122 days.
Achieve $1 billion in revenue by fiscal 2028 was dropped.
Expected capex of INR 400 crores in Q4 FY26 dropped.
OSAT Unit 2 commercialization by Q2 2026 is slipping.
Increase NPD contribution to 30% in coming years is pending.
PCB business FY27 expected INR 300 to 400 crores on track.
OSAT business FY27 expected INR 250 to 300 crores on track.
Turn cash positive by end of financial year is pending.
Kaynes Circuit Chennai operational by Q3 FY27 is pending.
First 3U satellite ready to launch next year is pending.
Planned capex of INR 300 crores OSAT and PCB is pending.
Planned capex of INR 250 crores EMS business is pending.
